description: List Dropscan mailings (physical mail), newest first. Optional review_status ('new'|'in_review'|'actioned'|'archived'), status (Dropscan-side: received|scan_requested|scanned|forward_requested|forwarded|destroy_requested|destroyed), only_deadlines (true = only mailings with a recognised Frist), due_days (Frist within N days), search (subject/sender/barcode). Returns the deadline, whether it looks like Behördenpost, and whether a scan is stored — use get_dropscan_mailing for the letter text.

due_days.description: Only mailings with a deadline within this many days

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

offset.description: Number of entries to skip (for paging)

only_deadlines.description: Only mailings with a recognised deadline (Frist)

review_status.description: Local triage status: new, in_review, actioned or archived

name: list_dropscan_mailings
